'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Garrett Larson DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents]]
* '''Username:''' deadbody
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
